_readme: Caption database for the #only-moo daily cow channel. The twice-a-day job
pairs a random caption with a random cow from lib/moo-cows.ts.
TOKENS (substituted at post time by renderCaption in lib/moo-captions.ts):
{boob} -> ZamboniBoob   {kuja} -> Kujatas
Become real @mentions when a Discord user id is configured, else bold names.
DYNAMIC TOKENS (only in dynamicTemplates[]; filled from Raider.IO once his
character is configured): {score} M+ score, {ilvl} item level,
{raid} raid progress like '5/8 M', {keylvl} a recent timed key level.
A dynamic template is skipped if its `needs` stat is unavailable.
FIELDS: text (required) - the caption with tokens.
tags - for mixing/weighting. cow|tauren|mechanics|beloved|meta|progress|healer|render.
note - optional dev comment, ignored at runtime.
RENDER POSTS: 'render'-tagged captions go with MOO_BOOB_RENDER (his actual
Tauren Paladin character in yellow 'pajamas', see lib/moo-cows.ts), NOT a
cow. The job should occasionally swap the cow for his render + a render
caption. Non-render captions pair with cow photos.
MIX GUIDANCE: focus is ZamboniBoob. Keep 'healer'/Kujatas lines RARE (a few
per hundred). The picker should down-weight 'healer' and avoid repeating a
caption within ~30 days. All ribbing is affectionate — he's beloved.
Target: grow toward ~150-200 static captions over time; the dynamic RIO
lines + rotating cow images carry the rest of the year's freshness.
